recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: NEET-UG examination 2026: One suspect arrested from Nashik - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the NEET-UG examination for 2026 after an alleged paper leak, leading to the arrest of a suspect in **Maharashtra**. The Rajasthan Police requested the **Maharashtra police** to detain the individual who was apprehended after changing his appearance.  The cancellation has drawn criticism from opposition leaders, including **Rohit Pawar**, who pointed out that the state government's new law against paper leaks is insufficient and called for stricter action against those involved. A CBI inquiry into the matter has been initiated.

recent_articles.title: NCP(SP) leader splashed with ink by right-wing preacher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vikas Lawande**, spokesperson for the **NCP(SP)**, was allegedly attacked with black ink in Pune, Maharashtra on Saturday by a group led by right-wing preacher **Sangram Bhandare**. The attack followed **Lawande's** remarks about **Bhandare's** gurus, who are part of the Warkari movement.  **Lawande** reported the incident to the police and demanded action against the attackers. Several political leaders, including **Shashikant Shinde**, **Mehbub Shaikh**, and **Vijay Wadettiwar**, condemned the attack and called for protection of free speech.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Legislative Council elections to be unopposed as Congress backtracks, Shinde fields two candidates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has withdrawn its decision to field a candidate for the nine Legislative Council seats in Maharashtra, supporting **Ambadas Danve** from **Shiv Sena UBT** after marathon meetings and phone calls between top leaders.  The decision was announced by **Maharashtra Congress president Harshawardhan Sapkal**, who also spoke alongside leaders of the Maha Vikas Aghadi. After a day of speculation, nine candidates filed their nominations for the seats, with each party securing its allotted quota.

recent_articles.title: Analysis: Why there is a ‘Pawar play’ over political legacy in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**'s legacy in **Baramati**, Maharashtra, is being challenged after the death of his nephew, **Ajit Pawar**.  The constituency, long dominated by the **Pawar** family, faces uncertainty as younger generations seek their own political paths. The BJP seeks to capitalize on this shift while the NCP and its allied party, **NCP (SP)**, grapple with internal divisions.

recent_articles.title: Baramati, Rahuri all set to conduct byelections on April 23 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** is holding by-elections in two constituencies, Baramati and Rahuri, on April 23, 2026.  The **Congress** withdrew its candidate from Baramati, paving the way for Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar to contest. The Baramati by-election is significant as it marks the first election since the death of the former MLA, Ajit Pawar. In Rahuri, the BJP's Akshay Kardile faces off against NCP-SP candidate Govind Mokate from the **Maha Vikas Aghadi**.

recent_articles.title: Bombay High Court quashes arrest of Sheetal Tejwani in two cases, upholds third - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sheetal Tejwani**, a businessperson, was found by the **Bombay High Court** to have been illegally arrested in two cases by the **Pimpri and Bavdhan police stations**. The court upheld her arrest in a third case at the **Khadak police station**.  The court ruled that the grounds of arrest were not communicated to Tejwani during her arrests, violating her constitutional rights.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: Why did the Congress withdraw its candidate from Baramati at the last minute? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NCP** and **NCP(SP)** leaders, including Sunetra Pawar, met with **Maharashtra Congress** president Harshawardhan Sapkal to request the withdrawal of their candidate from the Baramati by-election.  The Pawars argued for a united front against a competing candidate, while **Congress** leaders expressed disappointment over the lack of outreach from the **NCP**. The **Congress** eventually backed down and agreed to withdraw its candidate in response to pressure from allies and the **Pawar family**.

recent_articles.title: Title ‘Swatantryaveer’ not conferred by government on Savarkar, grandnephew tells court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Satyaki Savarkar**, the grandnephew of Vinayak Savarkar, testified in a defamation case against **Rahul Gandhi** before a special MP/MLA court in Pune. He stated that the title "Swatantryaveer" was not granted by any government and was given by writer **Sadashiv Ranade** in his biography.  He also confirmed that **Savarkar** studied in London during British rule, wrote several books under different names to avoid attention from authorities, and some of these works are available in libraries and archives. The cross-examination continues on April 13th.

recent_articles.title: Assembly elections 2026 LIVE updates: Voting begins in a single phase today in Assam, Kerala and Puducherry - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala**, **Assam**, and **Puducherry** held single-phase elections on April 9, 2026, with voting concluding at 5 p.m.  The results will be announced on May 4. The high-stakes elections in **Assam** are expected to see the BJP vying for a third consecutive term. In **Kerala**, three fronts – the CPI(M)-led LDF, the Congress-led UDF and the BJP-led NDA – are contesting across 140 constituencies.  The bypolls also took place in several states including Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Nagaland and Tripura.

recent_articles.title: Battleground Baramati: Ajit Pawar’s son faces criticism over ‘immature’ comments against Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parth Pawar**, son of **Sunetra Pawar** and late **Ajit Pawar**, has faced criticism from the **Congress** for his comments against the party. The **Congress** accused him of being ungrateful, a bad orator, and politically convenient.  The party also reminded him that the Karnataka government had registered an FIR in his father's death investigation. **Sharad Pawar**, his grandfather, and other family members have taken a contradictory stance, while allies of the **Congress** urged for an unopposed election in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: Battle for Baramati: Sunetra Pawar files nomination, Sharad Pawar’s photo displayed during NCP rally - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, daughter of **Sharad Pawar**, filed her nomination as the Nationalist Congress Party candidate for the upcoming Baramati by-election.  She was accompanied by Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde** and BJP cabinet minister **Chandrashekhar Bawankule**. **Sharad Pawar** expressed disapproval of his photo being displayed alongside **Narendra Modi** and **Amit Shah**, stating that it was wrong to do so. While senior NCP leaders, **Praful Patel** and **Sunil Tatkare**, suggested speaking with the Congress leadership for an unopposed election, Sunetra Pawar's son, **Parth**, indicated he would not engage in such negotiations.  **Sanjay Raut** of Shiv Sena UBT expressed that it was acceptable to field a candidate in elections.

recent_articles.title: New Rajya Sabha members take oath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, **Ramdas Athawale**, and 17 other new members were sworn in as Rajya Sabha members on Monday, April 6, 2026. The ceremony took place in the Rajya Sabha chamber with **C.P. Radhakrishnan** presiding.  The newly elected members represented various states including Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, and Odisha.

recent_articles.title: Akash Vishwanath More of Congress to contest Baramati Bypoll - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has selected **Advocate Akash Vishwanath More** as its candidate for the Baramati assembly by-election. The party's decision was made after the seat became vacant following the death of incumbent MLA and Deputy Chief Minister, **Ajit Pawar**.  **Sunetra Pawar**, wife of **Ajit Pawar**, will be filing her nomination from the Mahayuti.

recent_articles.title: MVA rift: Uddhav likely to back Sunetra Pawar in Baramati bypoll, but Congress not on board - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Congress** broke with its MVA partners, declaring it would contest the upcoming Baramati Assembly by-election.  **Sunetra Pawar**, widow of deceased NCP leader **Ajit Pawar**, is the ruling alliance's candidate. **Shiv Sena (UBT)** chief **Uddhav Thackeray** is expected to announce his party's decision soon, with sources indicating a likely support for **Sunetra Pawar**.  The Congress, however, has decided to contest the by-election independently, citing a lack of communication and participation in alliance discussions.

recent_articles.title: Sunetra Pawar to file nomination on April 6, contest won’t be unopposed in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, will file her nomination for the Baramati by-election on April 6th. The seat fell vacant after the death of her husband **Ajit Pawar** in an air crash earlier this year.  The election is expected to test the unity of the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance as allies may compete against each other. While the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has declared it will not field a candidate against Sunetra Pawar, the Maharashtra Congress and Shiv Sena UBT have expressed their intention to support a candidate in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) open to alliance with MNS for Maharashtra’s benefit, says Sanjay Raut - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, NCP (SP) chief, and six other candidates from the **Mahayuti alliance** filed nominations for seven Rajya Sabha seats in Maharashtra.  The ruling coalition's nominees are expected to be elected unopposed due to a lack of opposition. **Sanjay Raut**, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader, stated his party is willing to make concessions for the benefit of Maharashtra and its Marathi-speaking population.
